waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it, and TLC already stops with an evaluation error when an action leaves a variable unspecified.

mutations.name: drop-lease-check
mutations.why: RFill writes the value it read even when an invalidation happened since (the lease-token compare removed): a stale fill overwrites the invalidated cache.
mutations.search: /\ cache' = (IF UseLease /\ rtok[r] # gen THEN cache ELSE rval[r])
